name: Apache Pinot Self-Hosted Real-Time OLAP
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source distributed real-time analytical database with SQL queries and batch/stream ingestion, deployable on your own infrastructure without a vendor-imposed storage or query quota in the software.
watch_out: Self-hosted cluster compute, storage, networking, operations and streaming sources are not included. Managed Apache Pinot services are separate paid products; running a production cluster can require significant resources.
